bind_addr.description: Address and optional port to bind the HTTP API server (e.g., '0.0.0.0:8443' or '127.0.0.1:8443').

port.description: HTTPS port for the LXD API (used if `bind_addr` is not specified).

storage_path.description: Path to the directory where LXD stores its data (used only when storage.backend = dir).

auth_type.description: Authentication mode for the daemon API. 'trusted' requires client certs or passwords.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the server TLS certificate.

tls_key_path.description: Path to the server TLS private key.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to the CA or client certificate used for mutual TLS (optional).

restrict_unix_only.description: If true, only expose the Unix socket and disable the TCP listener (enhances security).

shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for graceful shutdown before force-terminating.

preload_images.description: If true, pre-download images to local storage during container start.

default_image_server.description: Default remote image server (URL or alias like 'images').

name.description: Name of the LXD-managed network bridge (e.g., lxdbr0).

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to assign to the bridge.

prefix_length.description: Subnet prefix length (e.g., 24 for IPv4, 64 for IPv6).

nat.description: Enable NAT for containers connected to this bridge.

bridges.description: List of LXD-managed bridges (one per entry). Required for container networking.

dns_servers.description: Upstream DNS servers for containers (comma-separated in config).

listen.description: Listen address:port (e.g., 0.0.0.0:8000) for a legacy proxy device.

connect.description: Target address:port (e.g., 127.0.0.1:80) to proxy traffic to.

proxies.description: List of legacy proxy listen/connect pairs (deprecated, prefer `lxc config device add`).

require_client_cert.description: If true, require trusted client TLS certificates to access the API (recommended for security).

allowed_networks.description: Allowed IPv4/IPv6 ranges for container NAT (used with `network.ipv4.nat.addresses`).

storage_pool.description: Name of the storage pool (used only for non-`dir` backends).

default_profile.description: Key-value pairs applied to all containers by default (e.g., user namespace mapping).

allowed_storage_volumes.description: Types of storage volumes allowed for this LXD instance.

allowed_instance_types.description: Instance types this LXD daemon may manage.

log_file_path.description: Path to the daemon log file. Use '-' to log to stdout only.
